method: Proposes temporal question answering approaches for news article collections.
key_assumptions: Temporal aspects of news articles can be modeled for QA.
main_contribution: Introduces methods for temporal QA over news collections.

relation_to_idea.conceptual_difference: Focuses on temporal QA for news articles, while our idea focuses on versioned regulatory documents for open-domain QA with temporal relevance weighting.
relation_to_idea.basis: Title suggests temporal QA in news.
